lines.say: The bank gives tokens one at a time. Not all thousand at once!
lines.cap: The bank gives tokens one at a time. Not all 1000 at once!

lines.say: Smart! Python can do that too. A generator, with yield!
lines.cap: Smart! Python can do that too. A generator, with yield!

lines.say: Level fifty! The finale! Generators, and yield!
lines.cap: Level 50! The finale! Generators and yield!

lines.say: Each yield hands out one token, then waits for the next request!
lines.cap: Each yield hands out ONE token, then waits for the next request!

lines.say: Return ends the function. Yield just pauses it, and remembers where it was!
lines.cap: return ENDS the function. yield just pauses it, and remembers where it was!

lines.say: So even an endless line is fine! Next asks for one more.
lines.cap: So even an endless line is fine! next() asks for one more.

lines.say: Your turn! Pause, and predict! What prints?
lines.cap: Your turn! Pause and predict! What prints?

lines.say: Yes! The first next took five. The generator continued from there!
lines.cap: Yes! The first next() took 5. The generator continued from there!

lines.say: You finished all fifty levels! Congratulations! Season two, Python for Data, is next!
lines.cap: You finished all 50 levels! Congratulations! Season 2: Python for Data, is next!
